messages:
elaine: Heads-up: billing flagged weird spikes where Console shows project=internal-tools but the token introspect says project=partner-xyz. looks like attribution precedence mismatch after the auth-proxy refactor
tom: i traced a few samples. proxy adds X-Project header for legacy partners; later the introspect service returns a validated claim. Console currently prefers header value for display and quotas
rashid: that's from the old behavior where header took precedence for compatibility. after the refactor we accidentally left that behavior on by default
elaine: consequences: (1) incorrect quota enforcement for some customer projects, (2) costing dashboards show wrong cost centers, (3) hurt for metered feature gating
tom: proposed change: canonicalize attribution to prefer token claim `project` when present, fallback to X-Project header only if claim missing. also emit a metric `project_attribution_source` with tags source:introspect|header|none
rashid: add `project_attribution_mismatch` counter when header != claim and sample traces for those requests (1 per second per org cap). that will help find partners intentionally using header overrides
elaine: UX: in the request inspector show a small note "Attribution: token claim (validated)" or "Attribution: header (legacy)" and a link to org settings that controls legacy header behavior
tom: need org-level compatibility toggle: "Allow legacy header attribution" default ON for existing orgs, OFF for new orgs. we should expose this in Console under Org Settings and via the admin API
rashid: implementation: change the auth-exchange service to set X-Effective-Project before routing. precedence: introspect.claim.project -> org-compatibility-override -> X-Project header -> anonymous_project
elaine: rollout: 1) add metrics + dashboards 2) unit/integration tests 3) enable behind feature-flag 4) canary 5) flip default for new orgs only
billing-oncall: we need an alert plan. recommend: alert if `project_attribution_mismatch` rate >5x baseline or any single project shows quota burn delta >15%/hour during canary
tom: agreed. also add a daily report during rollout listing top 20 orgs with highest mismatch counts so PMs can contact integrators
rashid: BC note: partners relying on header ordering get an org-toggle; we should also send automated emails to org admins with suggested migration steps and examples for exchanging header->claims
elaine: timeline estimate: auth-exchange PR and tests 1.5d, telemetry+dashboards 0.5d, Console toggle + docs 1d, canary infra+runbook 0.5d. target next Thursday deploy if no blockers
tom: i'll coordinate QA and SRE for canary window. will put the plan in #release-war-room and link the ticket
elaine: created ticket INF-8142 to track: "Normalize project attribution to validated token claims; add telemetry and org compatibility toggle"
auth-bot: Created INF-8142: "Normalize project attribution to validated token claims" assigned to rashid, elaine
billing-oncall: ping us 24h before canary. we'll monitor billing signals and be on-call
elaine: cool. let's keep discussion light here and move PR links and runbook into INF-8142
tom: starting the PR today, will link it here when ready
rashid: will add feature-flag toggles per-cluster for quick rollback
elaine: thanks everyone, appreciate quick turnaround
tom: thanks!
